The '''Imperial Badge of Meritorious Service''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded by [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] to individuals who were an "''outstanding example of heroism and bravery.''"<ref name="SWG:IBoMS" />

One such badge was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who served [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] dutifully during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities,<ref name="SWG:RtsIO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Rescue the sixth Imperial Officer|Corellia}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> The Imperial successfully rescued six Imperial officers from a prison facility in a [[Hidden Rebel Base|hidden Rebel base]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:RtsIO" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had a similar award named [[Rebel Alliance Badge of Valor]].<ref name="SWG:RABoV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rebel Alliance Badge of Valor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Badge of Meritorious Service appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IBoMS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Badge of Meritorious Service was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and could be obtained during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events<ref name="SWG:IBoMS" /> in 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref>
